title: Leaned website sections, cut tour to a URL card
summary: A vertical tour of one website: four page sections on a leaned 3D plane, each a slow camera move of 3-4 s joined by hard cuts, closing on a small serif URL on black. Depth and drift make a static site feel filmed.
use_when: A studio, agency or freelancer shows off a site it built, vertical feed
A landing page with a hero, a services block, a form and contact details
Silent autoplay where the UI itself has to carry the film
A short portfolio piece that must end on the URL

look.type_style: page headline in a light high-contrast serif, sentence case, one italic accent word, ~5 % H; body in a wide grotesk; tracked uppercase mono for bullet lists; URL close in a condensed serif ~2 % H

sfx.event: hard cut to the next page section
cut to the URL on black

structure.shot: page hero on a leaned plane: 3-line serif headline, 4-line sub, filled and ghost buttons, two big stat figures low
structure.camera: push-in 1.00->1.03 over 93 fr (motion.json ~1 %/s), plane leaned back with its left edge receding
structure.motion: no element animation visible at 4 fps; only the camera creep, easings.linear

structure.shot: services block: tail of an intro paragraph, 3-item mono bullet list, then a card with an icon tile, a 2-word title, 3-line body, 3 mono bullets
structure.camera: dolly up the plane ~4.3 px/fr @1920 (content rises) + push-in ~1.00->1.22 over 98 fr, roll ~+1 deg/s
structure.motion: content static on the plane; move is easings.linear across the whole row (no ease visible at 0.25 s)

structure.shot: inquiry form on a steeply leaned plane: blurred serif heading and sub, 3 labelled fields, wide dark pill submit button sharp at the bottom
structure.camera: plane tilted so the right edge falls away into dark; lateral dolly left ~1.9 px/fr @1920 with roll ~+2 deg/s; first 0.5 s eases out of a slight pull-out (-2 %/s)
structure.motion: shallow depth of field fixed on the button, top of the form blurred; no element animation; easings.linear drift

structure.shot: contact card on black, skewed in perspective: tracked mono eyebrow, then email, phone, social handle, city, each with a round icon chip
structure.camera: lateral dolly right ~4.5 px/fr @1920 (card slides right), slight push-in ~1 %/s, roll ~-0.7 deg/s
structure.motion: card static on the plane; easings.linear across 124 fr

structure.shot: the site URL, one small condensed serif line, centred on near-black
structure.motion: URL is fully on screen at the first cell after the cut (14.27); no entrance or exit visible at 0.25 s; holds 89 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: serif display, grotesk body, mono for lists and eyebrows, fg navy, accent for the buttons, bg off-white
params.content.hero: headline (3 short lines, one italic accent word), 4-line sub, two button labels, two stat figures with labels
params.content.services: intro sentence tail, 3 mono bullets, one service card: icon, 2-word title, 3-line body, 3 bullets
params.content.form: form heading (2 lines), 4-line sub, 3 field labels, submit label
params.content.contact: eyebrow + 4 contact rows (email, phone, handle, city) with icons
params.timing.sections: frames at 30 fps per section (default 93, 98, 110, 124), close holds 89

notes: Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (origin planned). Camera speeds come from motion.json global estimates (px/s normalised to 1920, %/s zoom, deg/s roll), cross-checked on sheet cell positions; easing curves are not measurable at 4 fps and are given as linear defaults. Row 4 is 4.13 s with no visible state change, so it is not split. Theme light by runtime (rows 1-3 and the card in row 4); the last 2.97 s are dark. Proposed term plane-dof (static shallow depth of field on a tilted plane, row 3) is covered by TiltPlane dof and not used as an id. Catalogue hint social-promo overridden: no sticker grammar, the content is a website UI.
